items.prompt: Why use n-1 for iid centered sample variance with a finite population variance?

options.text: It guarantees valid uncertainty for any dependent time series
It proves the sample is representative
options.why: A denominator choice cannot repair selection bias.
Estimating the mean changes the expected centered-square sum.

options.text: It makes the sample standard deviation unbiased automatically
options.why: The square root is nonlinear and needs its own analysis.

items.explanation: The correction concerns the expectation of the variance estimator, not universal data quality or unbiasedness of every transformed statistic.
